description: TCP Relay that enables multiple connections to a single TCP source port. Supports both duplex (bidirectional) and readable (downlink-only) relay ports.

sourceAddress.title: Source Address
sourceAddress.description: Address of the source TCP socket to connect to

sourcePort.title: Source Port
sourcePort.description: Port of the source TCP socket to connect to

serverMode.title: Server Mode
serverMode.description: If true, act as a TCP server for the source connection instead of connecting to an active server

duplexPorts.title: Duplex Ports
duplexPorts.description: Relay ports that support both reading and writing (bidirectional). Data written to these ports is relayed back to the source.

readablePorts.title: Readable Ports
readablePorts.description: Relay ports that only support reading (downlink-only). Data written to these ports will be dropped with a warning.
